sections.title: 1. Data Usage Policy
sections.content: iCampusPro collects personal and institutional information solely for providing, securing, and enhancing educational campus management services. We process basic contact details, academic administration records, attendance summaries, and enquiry submissions as authorized by registered educational organizations. Information is strictly segmented per institution and is never sold to third-party advertisers or unauthorized brokers.

sections.title: 2. User Rights
sections.content: Under applicable data protection laws, registered users, parents, students, and institute representatives retain the right to: (a) request access to personal information stored on iCampusPro, (b) request prompt rectification of inaccurate records, (c) request deletion of contact enquiries or user profiles subject to statutory retention guidelines, and (d) withdraw consent for non-essential notifications at any time.

sections.title: 3. Payment & Subscription Data Handling
sections.content: All payment transactions, including institute software subscriptions and parent fee remittances, are processed securely through PCI-DSS Level 1 certified payment gateway partners. iCampusPro does not store complete debit/credit card numbers or banking credentials on public servers. Billing invoices and payment receipts are encrypted at rest using AES-256 standard encryption.

sections.title: 4. Contact for Disputes & Grievance Officer
sections.content: For privacy-related questions, data access requests, or dispute resolutions, please write to our designated Grievance & Privacy Officer at privacy@icampuspro.com or via postal dispatch to: iCampusPro Legal & Compliance Division, Cyber Heights, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201309, India. We acknowledge all grievances within 48 business hours.

sections.title: 5. Security & Data Retention Practices
sections.content: We implement multi-factor authentication, SSL/TLS 1.3 transit encryption, automated vulnerability scanners, and role-based access control. Public registration enquiries and contact requests are retained for the duration required to service your query and maintain auditing records, after which they are archived or purged in accordance with our data governance framework.
